text: Added end-to-end dataset hierarchy fixtures. Shared DatasetMultiRunFixtureSuite exercises multi-subject/session/run DatasetIndex resolution, selected FmriSeries views, multi-run FmriDataset event/timeAxis alignment, selected-row run partitions, and typed DatasetError validation for bad event run labels.
